title: de Falco's extension of the monotonicity conjecture for the μ-permanent
statement: Let $A$ be a positive definite matrix, and let $P_\mu(A)$ denote its μ-permanent. **de Falco's conjecture.** There exists $\epsilon<-1$ such that $P_\mu(A)$ is a strictly increasing function of $\mu\in(\epsilon,+\infty)$. The statement extends the Bapat–Lal monotonicity conjecture beyond the interval $[-1,1]$; it is stated in the source as an open extension.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1804.02231

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2018).
source_name: Carlos M. da Fonseca, “The μ-permanent revisited”, arXiv:1804.02231 (2018).
